name: AI Assistant — v2 Event Runner + Agent Core

parameters.query:
WITH picked AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM agent_v3.events
    WHERE status = 'pending'
      AND run_at <= NOW()
    ORDER BY run_at, id
    FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
    LIMIT 10
),
claimed AS (
    UPDATE agent_v3.events e
    SET
        status = 'processing',
        locked_at = NOW(),
        attempts = attempts + 1,
        updated_at = NOW()
    FROM picked p
    WHERE e.id = p.id
    RETURNING e.*
)
SELECT
    c.id AS event_id,
    c.dialog_id,
    c.event_type,
    c.run_at,
    c.status AS event_status,
    c.payload,
    c.attempts,
    c.locked_at,

    d.airtable_dialog_id,
    d.airtable_task_id,
    d.person_name,
    d.person_role,
    d.telegram_username,
    d.telegram_user_id,
    d.telegram_chat_id,
    d.status AS dialog_status,
    d.waiting_for,
    d.followup_count,
    d.summary

FROM claimed c
JOIN agent_v3.dialogs d
  ON d.id = c.dialog_id
ORDER BY c.run_at, c.id;

UPDATE agent_v3.events
SET
    status = 'error',
    locked_at = NULL,
    last_error =
        'Event type is not implemented in Agent Core v9: ' || event_type,
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = {{ $json.event_id }}
RETURNING
    id AS event_id,
    dialog_id,
    event_type,
    status,
    last_error;

SELECT

  COALESCE(
    (
      SELECT jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'id', m.id,
          'direction', m.direction,
          'sender_type', m.sender_type,
          'message_type', m.message_type,
          'text', m.text,
          'telegram_created_at', m.telegram_created_at,
          'created_at', m.created_at
        )
        ORDER BY m.id
      )
      FROM (
        SELECT *
        FROM agent_v3.messages
        WHERE dialog_id = {{ $('Claim Due Events').item.json.dialog_id }}
        ORDER BY id DESC
        LIMIT 40
      ) m
    ),
    '[]'::jsonb
  ) AS recent_messages,

  COALESCE(
    (
      SELECT jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'scope', f.scope,
          'category', f.category,
          'fact_text', f.fact_text,
          'source_type', f.source_type
        )
        ORDER BY f.id
      )
      FROM agent_v3.facts f
      WHERE f.is_active = TRUE
        AND f.is_confirmed = TRUE
        AND f.airtable_task_id =
            '{{ $('Claim Due Events').item.json.airtable_task_id }}'
        AND (
          f.scope = 'task'
          OR
          (
            f.scope = 'dialog'
            AND f.dialog_id =
                {{ $('Claim Due Events').item.json.dialog_id }}
          )
        )
    ),
    '[]'::jsonb
  ) AS active_facts,

  COALESCE(
    (
      SELECT jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'id', r.id,
          'question', r.question,
          'context', r.context,
          'status', r.status
        )
        ORDER BY r.id
      )
      FROM agent_v3.owner_requests r
      WHERE r.dialog_id =
            {{ $('Claim Due Events').item.json.dialog_id }}
        AND r.status = 'open'
    ),
    '[]'::jsonb
  ) AS open_owner_requests;

nodes.name: Sync Nonblocking Owner Request to Airtable

parameters.query:
SELECT
    r.id AS owner_request_id,
    r.question AS owner_question,
    r.context AS owner_context,
    r.answer AS owner_answer,

    COALESCE(
      (
        SELECT jsonb_agg(
          jsonb_build_object(
            'id', m.id,
            'direction', m.direction,
            'sender_type', m.sender_type,
            'message_type', m.message_type,
            'text', m.text,
            'telegram_created_at', m.telegram_created_at,
            'created_at', m.created_at
          )
          ORDER BY m.id
        )
        FROM (
          SELECT *
          FROM agent_v3.messages
          WHERE dialog_id = {{ $('Claim Due Events').item.json.dialog_id }}
          ORDER BY id DESC
          LIMIT 40
        ) m
      ),
      '[]'::jsonb
    ) AS recent_messages,

    COALESCE(
      (
        SELECT jsonb_agg(
          jsonb_build_object(
            'scope', f.scope,
            'category', f.category,
            'fact_text', f.fact_text,
            'source_type', f.source_type
          )
          ORDER BY f.id
        )
        FROM agent_v3.facts f
        WHERE f.is_active = TRUE
          AND f.is_confirmed = TRUE
          AND f.airtable_task_id =
              '{{ $('Claim Due Events').item.json.airtable_task_id }}'
          AND (
            f.scope = 'task'
            OR (
              f.scope = 'dialog'
              AND f.dialog_id =
                  {{ $('Claim Due Events').item.json.dialog_id }}
            )
          )
      ),
      '[]'::jsonb
    ) AS active_facts

FROM agent_v3.owner_requests r
WHERE r.id =
      NULLIF(
        '{{ $('Claim Due Events').item.json.payload?.owner_request_id ?? '' }}',
        ''
      )::bigint
  AND r.dialog_id =
      {{ $('Claim Due Events').item.json.dialog_id }}
  AND r.status = 'answered'
LIMIT 1;

nodes.name: Sync Followup No Action to Airtable
Defer Paused or Cancel Done Event

parameters.content:
## v14.1 fix — Empty Queue Guard

`Claim Due Events` can return `{ success: true }` when no event rows were claimed.

The new `Has Claimed Event?` gate stops the workflow unless `event_id` exists.

This prevents Airtable `Get Task Status Guard` from receiving `airtable_task_id = undefined` during an empty queue.

All v14 owner-request idempotency logic is preserved.
